exposure: Maternal asymptomatic primary Toxoplasma gondii infection (diagnosed prenatally)
outcome: Congenital toxoplasmosis (Hydrocephalus, retinitis, choroiditis, intracranial calcifications - Sabin-Pinkerton triad)
cohort: A single male infant whose mother had an asymptomatic primary Toxoplasma gondii infection during pregnancy.
finding: Despite prenatal screening identifying maternal Toxoplasma gondii infection and immediate postnatal anti-toxoplasma therapy for the child, the absence of maternal antiparasitic treatment resulted in severe congenital toxoplasmosis and subsequent psychophysical development disorders in the infant.
